To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
FDI and ODA have a complementary relationship in complementary inputs and a substitutive relationship in other inputs.
FDI in developing countries can be a source of growth but its effect is highly dependent on the sector of activity.

(1) ODA and FDI are substitutable in the aggregate and complementary in the disaggregated; (2) Foreign firms in Vietnam are more productive and grow faster than their domestic counterpart but pay lower wages and are less profitable; (3) Processing exporters pay lower wages and earn lower profit than non processing exporters.
